features.title: Tasks and reminder catalogs keep their read until a schedule change
features.summary: The native Tasks page, task tabs and the Session header's reminders from one owned fork of the stock row. Behaviour is the native one; a reminder catalog subscribed again keeps its last read while no schedule/changed event or connection reset happened since, so reopening a thread or the Tasks page no longer rereads schedule/list. A subscribed catalog still rereads on every change and reset.
features.currentSurface: sidebar: Tasks page, task tabs and the Session header's reminders

onboarding.firstAction: Open the Tasks page from the sidebar.
onboarding.doneWhen: Your scheduled tasks and reminders show in one list.

failureModes: A change missed while nothing subscribed moves the page-wide revision, so the next subscriber reads again instead of keeping a stale list.
A refused read keeps the native error state; the next change or reset reads again.

telemetry.reason: Client-only fork: it calls the native schedule Remote methods whose Host spans belong to core; the Host half is the native no-op.
